title: Transfer flat global-sections opcycles to affine sheaf opcycles
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and a an integer. Assume C^(a-1) and C^a are quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Let P be its termwise global-sections complex of A=Gamma(S,O_S)-modules. If P.opcycles a is flat over A [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then C.opcycles a is flat over the identity S -> S [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. No hypothesis on any other term or on homology is imposed.

source.place: Tags 01IB (affine equivalence), 01HV (associated sheaf localization), and 01U4 (affine-local flatness); step 4 of lem-pc-affine-universally-exact-opcycles-flat.

proof.text: Identify the sheaf and section-complex opcycles with cokernels of the differential from degree a-1 to degree a. Restrict the sheaf differential along the top affine chart Spec Gamma(S,O) -> S. The affine counit and preservation of cokernels by tilde give tildeCokernelIso. The section restriction linear equivalences are natural in the differential; cokernel.mapIso, tilde.isoTop, and preservation of cokernels by chart restriction therefore identify the module opcycles with Gamma(S,C.opcycles a). Cokernel closure gives quasi-coherence of the sheaf opcycles. These constructions use only the two specified quasi-coherent terms.

Transfer the assumed flatness through the module cokernel comparison. Rewrite equal-open identity appLE to the identity action. For each point, affine_sections_stalk_tensor_presentation on the top affine open identifies the module stalk with extension of scalars of the now-flat global sections, so it is flat over the stalk ring by Module.Flat.baseChange.

For an arbitrary affine open U and each maximal ideal P of B=Gamma(U,O), take x=U.fromSpec(P). The stalk ring at x is a localization of B at P. The canonical map Gamma(U,C.opcycles a) -> O_x tensor_B Gamma(U,C.opcycles a) is an IsLocalizedModule.AtPrime map. The affine stalk-tensor comparison identifies this tensor module with the flat sheaf stalk. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization gives flatness of that tensor module over B; Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal then gives flatness of Gamma(U,C.opcycles a) over B. The argument includes empty U and the zero ring without assuming maximal ideals exist.

For each affine pair U contained in the identity preimage of V, HasRingHomProperty.appLE applied to the flat identity morphism gives flatness of Gamma(U,O) over Gamma(V,O). Install exactly the appLE algebra and restricted module action from IsFlatOver. The scalar tower follows from mul_smul. Module.Flat.trans with the affine section flatness proves every required test.

theorem affine_opcycles_flat_from_sections (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hprev : (C.X (a - 1)).IsQuasicoherent) (hcurr : (C.X a).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hflat : Module.Flat Γ(S, ⊤)
      ((((SheafOfModules.evaluation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (.op ⊤) :
        S.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj C).opcycles a)) :
    (C.opcycles a).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)
